title: Elon Musk knows UFO secrets but can't say

tellings.quote: I talked about this with Dan yesterday on the Age of Disclosure podcast. Um, of course he knows,

plain: Joe Rogan, a popular podcast host, told podcaster Jesse Michels in 2025 that Elon Musk, the head of the rocket company SpaceX, surely knows secrets about UFOs but cannot talk about them. Rogan says he had discussed this the day before with a man named Dan on a podcast called Age of Disclosure, and that "of course he knows." If true, it would mean one of the world's best-known businessmen is keeping quiet about what he has learned.
